decisions.statement: The index is named for the unique kind it files.
A file is found by the page type then the property then the value.
A scope is the page type the value is unique within.
A slug reaches an id without opening the page.
A file has one line for each page with the value.
A page type no page is filed under has no directory.
A page with an identifier another page already has does not land.
A page type is read off the page rather than off the path the page sits at.

definition: an index from an identifier unique within a page type to the page with it
